description: Read a committee document page: its headline, publication date, the text the committee published, and the attached documents (usually PDFs — letters, transcripts, reports) with URLs and sizes. Pass a url from search_committee_documents. Note that PDF text is NOT extracted — attachments are returned as links, so quote the page text and cite the attachment URL rather than claiming to have read the PDF.

url.description: Full committee document URL, as returned by search_committee_documents

name: get_committee_document
title: Get Committee Document
